'''Jincao Plot''' is an [[AIC]] [[Facilities|facility]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Item description|To use this plot, follow the steps of fine cultivation and harvest the ripened crops to get plenty of Jincao and a higher chance of Fluffed Jincao.|A cultivation plot with various parameters adjusted for growing jincao. Overall soil quality of the plot is far better than that of the average arable land in Wuling.}}
